meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 把项目从开始到现在的完整开发过程,整理成一份带章节的长篇叙事报告,包含项目起源、架构变化、关键突破、遇到的技术债与难题、记忆回放节省的工作量等定量统计,并保存为 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求写时间线报告、项目历史分析、开发历程或完整项目报告,例如提到"时间线报告""项目旅程""分析项目历史"或"整个开发历程总结"时触发。

say.text: 写一份 tokyo 项目的完整开发历程报告。
say.note: 会拉取该项目全部开发记录并生成叙事报告

say.text: 分析一下当前项目的整个开发历史。
say.note: 会按当前目录识别项目名并开始分析

say.text: 这个项目一路走来经历了哪些关键转折?
say.note: 报告会专门梳理方向性转变和突破点

howto.what_en: Turn the project's full development history into a long-form narrative report with chapters (genesis, architecture evolution, breakthroughs, tech debt, ROI statistics) and save it as a Markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report, e.g. "timeline report", "project journey", "analyze project history", or "summarize the entire development history".

say_en.text: Write a journey report for the tokyo project.
say_en.note: It pulls all observations and writes the narrative

say_en.text: Analyze the full development history of the current project.
say_en.note: Uses the current directory's project name

say_en.text: What were the key turning points in this project?
say_en.note: The report highlights major pivots and breakthroughs
